about: The review app's model picker (server.py /api/models). The numbers come from MODEL_STATUS.md: the checks from "Every scenario kind: one model", the speeds from "Deployment". Keep the two in step.
speed: Per frame, one 1280 x 720 frame on the Ryzen 7 9800X3D and RTX 5070 Ti, measured per model size (small, full): GPU is PyTorch in batches of 16, CPU is ONNX Runtime fp32 on 4 threads, browser is onnxruntime-web on WASM.

checks.name: Tracking
checks.what: time on the bot minus the stats file's accuracy: mean, and mean size (nearer 0 is better)

checked_on: Recordings no model trained on, against their stats files (eval_moving.py).

full_v3.trained: Every scenario kind: static, dynamic, switching and tracking.
full_v3.best: The most accurate on moving runs: the most flicks measured on dynamic and switching runs, and tracking nearest the stats files.
full_v3.weak: 2.3 times small_v13's compute. On the Aim Lab upload it measures 8 fewer flicks than small_v11.

full_v6.trained: full_v3 fine-tuned on full_v5's checked crops and 309 robot crops checked by eye, one box per whole robot.
full_v6.best: Boxes a robot whole: Smoothbot Switch Robots matches 55 of 55 kills. Passes the acceptance gate against full_v3 (MODEL_STATUS.md).
full_v6.weak: Tracking a little farther from the stats files than full_v3 (mean gap size 0.141 against 0.117, within the gate's limit).

full_v8_orange.trained: full_v6 fine-tuned with the 2026-10-05 labels and 354 health-bar crops checked by eye, the bar crossed out: orange and red bars only.
full_v8_orange.best: Taught that bots' health bars are no targets.
full_v8_orange.weak: Not gated: its gate was stopped. Never shown a bar of another color.

hand.label: Hand-written
hand.trained: No training: the rule-based finder in review.py. The first training labels came from it.
hand.best: Needs no model files and no GPU.
hand.weak: It assumes dark targets, so it fails on other colors and themes, and on a target under the crosshair (Pokeball scenarios).
